title: Megurine Luka — Feelings From Each SEKAI〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This place really is overflowing with so many feelings.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I wonder if these fragments, too, will someday become SEKAI just like theirs.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That reminds me. There have been some big changes in those SEKAI as of late.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It makes sense, as they make their dreams come true and strive toward new horizons...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. There will be so much more to see from them.

rows.Speaker: Someone's Voice
rows.Line: “It's like I told you. Share a secret with someone, and it will bring you closer.”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I thought I heard a voice just now...

rows.Speaker: Someone's Voice
rows.Line: “Oh, don't be such a sourpuss. I was born from the feelings that make up this SEKAI, same as you.”

rows.Speaker: Someone's Voice
rows.Line: “Len, don't bring your marshmallow so close to the fire. It'll burn.”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: These voices... Are they me, from other SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: A SEKAI's Luka
rows.Line: “Hehe... I can hear everyone laughing and having fun.”

rows.Speaker: A SEKAI's Luka
rows.Line: “Yes... The flowers we all drew together are just so beautiful.”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: There they are again... And from different SEKAI this time.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But why, all of a sudden...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? The fragments of feelings are gathering together...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Where am I?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I can sense so many feelings here.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This must be a SEKAI formed by those fragments that gathered together...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? What are these?
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They look almost like photos... And they show me, from different SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Here, and there, and there... Far too many to count.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And strong emotion radiates from each one...

rows.Speaker: Stage SEKAI Miku
rows.Line: “Hey, Luka. What kind of spell did you cast?”

rows.Speaker: Stage SEKAI Luka
rows.Line:
“Hehe, you know I can't cast any spells.
But it would be lovely if I could ♪”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But you only just met Shizuku, right? And you still gave her such good advice.
bgm_area00002

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's like I told you. Share a secret with someone, and it will bring you closer.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If you share secrets with them, too, then I'm sure you'll get along even better in no time.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Secrets...
Hmm, I don't know if there's anything I haven't already talked to Shizuku and the others about already.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: There's no need to overthink it♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: After all, the secret I shared with Shizuku is that my cheeks are very soft.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You shee? Shuper shoft♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Wow, they really are! I bet your cheeks are the squishiest out of everyone in this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I wouldn't be surprised if I have the softest cheeks of any Luka across all SEKAI♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That must have been a memory of the Luka from Minori and her friends' SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That was a little startling at first. But it seems that if I touch these photo-like things, I can get a glimpse into the emotions that made them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I wonder if this SEKAI has something it wants to tell me?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I'll try touching another set of memories.
Let me see...
bgm_area00005
se_walk_men_001_1
se_walk_men_001_1
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_men_001_1
se_walk_men_001_1
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Stop following me. Go away.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, don't be such a sourpuss. I was born from the feelings that make up this SEKAI, same as you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So why don't we play a nice round of cat's cradle? To get to know one another better.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hardly. You just want to play.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, but you need proper understanding of one another to play cat's cradle.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: For example, you should understand that I'm stubborn enough to follow you around until you say yes.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Tch. None of the others are pushy like this, so why is it just you?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What point is there in us understanding each other? It won't help Mafuyu discover who she really is.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I don't think it has anything to do with that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: After all...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We're in this together. That's reason enough to get to know each other.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You must be the single most infuriating Luka there is across all the SEKAI out there.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Why, thank you. It's always nice to hear you're the best at something.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: ...I'm amazed she was able to keep up her smile in the face of such a sullen KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Maybe she is the best out of all of us, in some sense.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Out of all of us...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I feel as though I've begun to understand what this fragment SEKAI is about.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: To be sure, I'll have to look into more of these memories from other versions of myself.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Next is...
